prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. The evidence shows that your insured struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped in traffic. Under the applicable traffic laws, a driver who fails to keep a safe distance and fails to stop in time bears responsibility for the resulting harm, and there is no comparable fault on the part of our client.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a significant knee injury. Medical records document the diagnosis, the treatment prescribed, and the physical therapy required to restore function. Our client has experienced ongoing pain, reduced mobility, and time away from work, and the full extent of the recovery remains under evaluation by treating physicians.

Our client has incurred substantial medical expenses, lost wages, and damage to the vehicle, and continues to suffer non-economic losses including pain, inconvenience, and diminished quality of life. These damages are fully documented and will be provided upon request.

To resolve this matter without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we are prepared to file suit to recover the full measure of our client's damages, together with costs and interest as allowed by law.
